ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is needed to restrict the user to create Id Upload Task if the case is KYC QA Case and Status is not Pending Documents or Documents Uploaded
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Nudge', ISPICKVAL(Type,'TASK_TYPE_ID_UPLOAD'), Case__r.RecordType.DeveloperName ='KYC_QA', ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Status,'Pending Documents')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Status,'Documents Uploaded')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only send a task when the Case Status is Pending Documents or Documents Uploaded.
